name: cql-cds-pipeline
description: Automated CQL to ELM compilation workflow with Express CDS Service

scripts.compile: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('elm',{recursive:true})" && java -cp "tools/lib/*" org.cqframework.cql.cql2elm.cli.Main -i cql/screening.cql -o elm --format JSON && java -cp "tools/lib/*" org.cqframework.cql.cql2elm.cli.Main -i cql/liver-screening.cql -o elm --format JSON
